stem: In the figure, \(AB\) is a diameter of the circle with center \(O\), and point \(C\) lies on the circle. Angle \(CAB\) measures \(34^{\circ}\). What is the measure, in degrees, of angle \(ABC\)?
solution: An angle inscribed in a semicircle is a right angle, so angle \(ACB\) measures \(90^{\circ}\).
The angles of triangle \(ABC\) sum to \(180^{\circ}\): \(180 - 90 - 34 = 56\).
verify:
P=figure['points']
d=lambda a,b: sqrt((P[a][0]-P[b][0])**2+(P[a][1]-P[b][1])**2)
ang=lambda a,v,b: N(acos(((P[a][0]-P[v][0])*(P[b][0]-P[v][0])+(P[a][1]-P[v][1])*(P[b][1]-P[v][1]))/(d(a,v)*d(b,v)))*180/pi)
assert all(abs(d('O',p)-5)<0.01 for p in 'ABC')
assert abs(ang('A','C','B')-90)<0.1 and abs(ang('C','A','B')-34)<0.1
ans=180-90-34
assert abs(ang('A','B','C')-ans)<0.1
assert Rational(spr_answers[0])==ans
